subject: Neptune Health - delegated access ownership, SCIM snapshot & SAML assertion samples
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@neptunehealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@neptunehealth.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request - delegated admin + SCIM / SAML samples

Marcus / team,

Thanks for taking time on the call this morning. As part of our SIG + CAIQ intake we need a short artifact set to validate delegated access boundaries and provisioning controls before our procurement team can clear your deployment for PHI workloads. Specific asks from our security intake: 

- SCIM delta sample (last 7 days) showing user create/update/delete events, including source system and timestamp. CSV or JSON OK.
- SAML assertion samples for a standard login flow and an elevated-role login (service admin). We need raw assertion logs (redact PII if needed) and timestamps.
- Owner of record mapping: for accounts with delegated roles (admins, integrators), a simple owner_roster export (email, role, owner-of-record).
- Short narrative on how least-privilege for delegated admins is enforced and how JIT elevation is audited. 

Can you send the artifacts or a delivery ETA? We prefer secure dropbox / SFTP. Also let us know any expected redaction steps so we can sign an NDA if necessary.

Appreciate it,
Alex Porter
Security Engineer, Neptune Health
security@neptunehealth.com

---

Attachments referenced: none in this message.

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@neptunehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request - delegated admin + SCIM / SAML samples

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver all three items. Quick notes and plan: 

- SCIM delta sample: we can export a 7-day delta CSV with columns (user_id, action, source_system, changed_fields, timestamp). Will scrub device identifiers and OIDC sub claims.
- SAML assertions: we will pull SP-side assertion logs for two flows (standard user, delegated-admin elevation). We will redact email addresses if you prefer tokens instead.
- Owner roster snapshot: we'll export the current role mapping for tenants scoped to Neptune Health.
- Narrative: 1-page summary on RBAC enforcement and JIT elevation audit links + where the logs live.

Delivery ETA: EOD Thursday (2026-05-14) via secure Drive link. If you need sooner, we can prioritize the SCIM sample first.

Folks looping in: Marissa (CS) to coordinate tenant scoping and Jonas (Security eng) for assertion redaction guidance.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none in this message.

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@neptunehealth.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverables: SCIM delta + SAML assertions + owner roster (neptune tenant)

Alex — putting the artifacts on the secure share now. Short checklist of what I uploaded: 

1) scim_delta_sample_20260512.csv (attached) — 7-day delta with source_system flag (API/SCIM/CLI), action column (create/update/delete), changed_fields and ISO timestamps. Redacted OIDC subs and device ids.
2) saml_assertion_samples_20260512.log (attached) — two SP assertion captures (standard user login, delegated-admin elevation). All PII replaced with stable tokens (user_token_#). Assertion signatures preserved.
3) owner_roster_snapshot_20260512.csv (attached) — current owner-of-record mapping for Neptune Health tenant.
4) ownership_narrative_20260513.txt — one page on RBAC model, delegated admin controls, JIT elevation flow and where to find audit trails (CloudAudit -> retention 90 days default).

Delivery method: secure Drive link (internal) + I shared a link to the Neptune security mailbox (dropbox alternative). HubSpot deal HP-2345 updated with artifacts.

Action items: 
- Alex: confirm receipt and whether tokenized assertions are acceptable for your review.
- Marissa: please follow up with procurement about the evidence package and any additional export formats they require.

Thanks — ping me if you want a short walkthrough of the SAMLP flow.

— Jonas Weber
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim_delta_sample_20260512.csv; saml_assertion_samples_20260512.log; owner_roster_snapshot_20260512.csv; ownership_narrative_20260513.txt

From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@neptunehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-13T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deliverables: SCIM delta + SAML assertions + owner roster (neptune tenant)

Jonas / Marcus / Marissa — got the package and skimmed the artifacts this morning. A couple quick clarifications before procurement signs off: 

1) For the SAML assertions, signatures look intact — tokenization is fine. Can you also include the IdP entityID and SP ACS URL used in the sample? That helps our replay checks.
2) In the owner_roster_snapshot CSV can you add a "last_verified" column (date) for owners-of-record? If not, tell us how you track verification cadence.
3) On the RBAC narrative: can you add a one-line description of automated role pruning (if any) or whether role revocation is tied to SCIM termination events?

If you can drop a quick follow-up with those three items, procurement will be able to close the SIG intake this afternoon. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Alex Porter
Security Engineer, Neptune Health
security@neptunehealth.com

---

Forwarded-attachments: scim_delta_sample_20260512.csv; saml_assertion_samples_20260512.log; owner_roster_snapshot_20260512.csv
